SELECT cls, (CAST(fish_date_doy AS INT)/10)*10 AS doy_bucket,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS share_per_angler,
       SUM(anglers) AS anglers, COUNT(*) AS boat_days, COUNT(DISTINCT fish_date_season) AS n_seasons
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter')
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT cls, CAST(FLOOR(fish_date_doy/15)*15 AS INT) AS doy_bucket,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS share_per_angler,
       SUM(anglers) AS anglers, COUNT(*) AS boat_days, COUNT(DISTINCT fish_date_season) AS n_seasons
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter')
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT avail_season AS season, CAST(FLOOR(avail_doy/30)*30 AS INT) AS doy_bucket, ROUND(AVG(value),3) AS oni
FROM climate WHERE index_id='oni'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
